summary.intent: Use the GSD manager workflow to drive milestone v2.0 of the cipher-box repo to completion — dashboard-review phase statuses, verify Phase 70.1's SC#6 crash-safety test, fix a false 'partial' status on Phase 69, then plan and execute follow-on phases (74, 75, 77) in parallel worktrees, resuming autonomously across quota resets.
summary.outcome: Phase 70.1 was fully verified (SC#6 live-stack test passed 6/6 after fixing a stale API process and an unexported test secret) and Phase 69's false 'Executing' status was traced to a plan-scanner substring bug and fixed; both landed via PR #606 merged to main. A scheduled autonomous resume then re-planned and executed Phase 74 to completion (code-verified, CI-gated legs pending) while Phase 75 was left mid-flight (5 plans committed, validation blocker resolved, execution not yet run) when the transcript ends.

repo: gsd-core's plan-file scanner (`plan-scan.cjs:28`) has a loose `/PLAN/i` substring fallback that miscounts any `.md` file containing 'PLAN' (e.g. `*-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md`) as an extra plan, causing `implementation_complete:false` and a false 'partial'/'Executing' dashboard status.

The manager dashboard's `is_active` flag just means 'a file in the phase dir was modified in the last 5 minutes' (init.cjs:1140) — not that an agent is actually running; editing any file in a completed phase's dir will flip it to 'active' misleadingly.

`gsd_run phase uat-passed <N> --require-verification` treats implementation-complete + verification-passed but no UAT.md as not-fully-done, downgrading disk_status to 'partial' — phases verified via CI/cargo (not conversational UAT) need a manually-authored UAT stub to read as complete.

The live API dev process on :3000 can silently be a stale `node dist/main.js` build (detached, PPID 1) serving old code/secrets instead of the current source — must verify process identity/start-time before trusting local test results against it.
vitest does not load `.env` files, so `sdk-e2e` test harness silently falls back to a default test secret unless `SDK_E2E_SECRET` is explicitly exported in the shell before running the suite.
EnterWorktree cannot pin a sub-agent launched from the repo root into a pre-existing worktree — the sub-agent ends up operating on the main checkout instead, silently defeating worktree isolation.

git commits in this repo are unsigned (`commit.gpgsign=false`), so autonomous/background commits don't block on 1Password biometric prompts; slow commits are usually just lint-staged pre-commit hooks (~1-2 min in this monorepo), not a signing hang.

code.finding: Loose fallback regex matches any .md filename containing 'PLAN' (case-insensitive) as a plan file if it's not a *-SUMMARY.md, causing false positives like *-WRITE-PLANE-RESEARCH.md
is_active is computed purely from 'file modified in last 5 minutes' in the phase dir, not from any real process/agent liveness check

workflow: When a live docker stack + API is required for a test suite, verify both the API process's source freshness (dist vs live source) and the test harness's actual loaded env vars before trusting a red/skip result as a real code failure.

Before recommending a fix for a mysterious dashboard/status discrepancy, trace the root cause through the actual resolver code rather than iterating on guesses (UAT stub didn't fix Phase 69; the real cause was a scanner regex bug found only by reading plan-scan.cjs directly).

When background/worktree-isolated planning agents die mid-run (e.g. from a session quota limit), their worktree may still have committed partial progress (branch renamed, research/patterns committed) — inspect disk state directly rather than assuming a total loss and replanning from scratch.
Scheduling a one-shot cron resume plus a secondary 'safety-net' cron resume (for the next quota reset) is a reasonable hedge for long autonomous runs expected to outlast one quota window.

friction: A background planner agent (Phase 74/75) attempted `EnterWorktree` from the repo root into a pre-existing worktree and failed identically twice, wasting a cycle before pivoting to switching the main checkout per feat branch sequentially.
Diagnosing the Phase 69 'partial' status required multiple wrong turns (UAT stub, is_active investigation, plan_count investigation) before finding the real root cause in plan-scan.cjs.

Session hit the Claude usage quota mid-task (session limit resets 4:40am Europe/Berlin) while three background planners were mid-flight, killing all three without producing plans, requiring a full autonomous resume and reassessment.
Phase 75's resumed agent stopped early after ~21 minutes citing a 'flawed background-wait' internal issue (not quota-related), requiring a manual relaunch to actually finish planning + execution.
A shell glob for staging Phase 74's draft plan commit expanded against the wrong (empty) cwd instead of the worktree, requiring a quoted git pathspec workaround.
`.env` grep for inspecting the API's secret config was denied (blocked as reading a secret file), requiring a workaround of reading only package scripts instead.
open_items: Phase 75 execution had not yet run at end of transcript — 5 plans committed and validation blocker resolved, but plan-checker pass + execution still pending.
Phase 77 planning was interrupted by quota exhaustion before any plans were committed (worktree only had research/patterns) — status not confirmed resumed in the visible transcript.
Phases 76, 78, 79 remain entirely unplanned per the autonomous-resume instructions.

Phase 74's verification is code-complete (21/21 code-verified) but blocked on two CI-gated legs (Windows compile, desktop-e2e 3-platform matrix) that can't run on the macOS dev host — pending `/gsd-verify-work 74` after CI confirms.
None of the feat branches (74, 75, 77) have been merged or had PRs opened yet — they're sitting ready for review per the 'never commit/push directly to main' rule.
The manager/verify-work `phase uat-passed` CLI gap (already tracked in memory as feedback-gsd-phase-uat-passed-unimplemented) resurfaced conceptually via the Phase 69 UAT-stub workaround.
